As I sit here with my keyboard in front of me, I can't help but think about all the words that have passed through my mind over the course of my life. Every single word has had its own unique meaning and purpose, and yet not all of them have been given the chance to be seen by the world.

Some words are born out of inspiration and are used to express the most profound thoughts and emotions. They have the power to move people, to inspire them and to connect them to something greater than themselves. These are the words that are worth saving, the words that will live on long after the author has passed on.

Other words, however, are nothing more than a fleeting thought or a moment of inspiration. They have no real purpose or meaning, and they are quickly forgotten. These are the words that should be discarded, the words that serve no purpose other than to clutter our minds and fill our ears with unnecessary noise.

But even as I discard the unnecessary words, I can't help but think about the words that have been left behind. The words that have been rejected, the words that have been hidden away. These are the words that are truly special, the words that have the power to change the world.

And then there are the words that are used to deceive, to manipulate and to deceive. These words are the most dangerous of all, for they have the power to destroy lives, to tear families apart and to cause endless suffering. They must be watched with great care and must be avoided at all costs.

As I sit here writing these words, I am reminded of the power that language has over the world. The words we choose to use can either bring light or bring darkness, and it is up to us to make the right choices.

So let us be mindful of the words we use, and let us use them to inspire and connect rather than to divide and destroy. Let us use our words to make the world a better place, one word at a time.
